console.log((1234.567).toLocaleString('en-US',{
  localeMatcher:'lookup',style:'currency',currency:'USD',currencyDisplay:'narrowSymbol',currencySign:'accounting',
  useGrouping:'auto',minimumIntegerDigits:2,minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:3,
  minimumSignificantDigits:2,maximumSignificantDigits:6,numberingSystem:'latn',compactDisplay:'short',notation:'standard',
  signDisplay:'negative',unit:'meter',unitDisplay:'long',roundingPriority:'auto',roundingIncrement:1,
  roundingMode:'halfEven',trailingZeroDisplay:'auto'
}));
console.log('a'.localeCompare('A','en-US',{
  usage:'sort',localeMatcher:'best fit',numeric:true,caseFirst:'false',sensitivity:'base',collation:'default',ignorePunctuation:true
}));
console.log([1,2].toLocaleString('en-US',{dateStyle:'long',hour12:true,timeZone:'UTC'}));
console.log('abc'.toLocaleUpperCase(['en-US']),(1234n).toLocaleString('en-US'));
